summary: Iteration 42 — All 5 Portfolio-page enhancements verified end-to-end on priyanka (64 holdings). BACKEND (3/3 pytest PASS): (1) Redis cache works — cold load 17.23s, warm load 0.10s = 165× speedup; `_cache_hit` flips correctly false→true within TTL; POST /api/portfolio/refresh-stock-fundamentals invalidates cache (next GET returns `_cache_hit: false`). (2) Refresh endpoint new shape returns all required keys {ok, total, nifty_100_covered, search_resolved, search_failed, search_failed_details, duration_s}; priyanka: total=27, duration_s≈0.6s. (3) Equity scored coverage 27/28 = 96.4%; top-level coverage_pct=82.8% (was 52.8% — now exceeds 80% target); mid/small-caps DIGIDRIVE (cs=65.4), GABRIEL (cs=67.1), PRICOL (cs=74.5), IRB (cs=50.4) all have composite_score (previously unscored). FRONTEND: portfolio-header renders with h1='Portfolio' + subtitle '64 holdings across 4 asset classes · Last refreshed 23 Apr, 10:23 am · 82.8% scored' + 3 buttons (header-refresh-scores, header-export-csv, header-reload). 53 stars-{1..5} pills render on rows (stars-1=1, stars-2=6, stars-3=27, stars-4=19, stars-5=0) with 'Nivesh Rating' fallback label present 223× on page. filter-WEAK pill renders; direct click drops visible rows 64→7 (all scores 29/43/48/39/39/42/48 i.e., composite<50). CTA behaviors: cta-alert-allocation click keeps hash=#portfolio (NO navigation to plan_board) and rows stay in table view; cta-alert-diversification click keeps hash=#portfolio AND activates WEAK filter (bg-slate-900 text-white styling, 7 rows shown). header-refresh-scores click triggers /api/portfolio/refresh-stock-fundamentals 200 and invalidates cache (next GET hits 17s cold reload — confirmed 'Loading portfolio...' spinner). Regression testids all still present: impact-strip, score-legend, asset-tab-{all,mutual_fund,equity,etf}, row-why-*, cta-alert-cost, Switch modal. NO issues found.

minor.issue: Field `nifty_100_covered` is a misnomer — it actually counts any symbol already persisted in stock_master (union of Nifty-100 + previously-search-resolved). On priyanka's second run: nifty_100_covered=27, search_resolved=0 (because mid-caps were already persisted from prior runs). Spec docstring says search_resolved>=15 but that only holds on a fresh DB. Consider renaming to `already_scored` or `master_covered` for clarity; `search_resolved` only reflects *newly* searched symbols in the current call.

issues: ActionPlanManager modal still auto-opens on landing and requires Escape to dismiss — pre-existing, carried over from iterations 39/40/41.
Subtitle line runs everything together visually at narrow widths; '·' separators work but wrapping into 2-3 metadata rows could improve mobile readability. Non-blocking.

groww_stock_scraper.py search_groww_by_symbol() + refresh_user_stocks() two-phase strategy (Nifty-100 → Groww search fallback) correctly resolves all 4 tested mid/small-caps. The `already` set at line 752-759 uses stock_master membership as the 'covered' proxy — works but makes `nifty_100_covered` misleadingly named.

ActionablePortfolioView.js — at 741 lines (up from 664 in iter41), now past the 700-line threshold flagged earlier. Recommend extracting PortfolioHeader + StarRating + AlertCTA into sub-components next iteration.

No hash mutation — aligns with 'filter in-place' spec. Verified via DOM click tests (hash stays #portfolio, WEAK pill goes active).
